semiconductor_relevance: High — Anji Microelectronics is a key supplier of advanced materials specifically for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Anji Microelectronics specializes in developing and manufacturing advanced materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) slurries and resist stripping cleaning solutions. The company supports its global customers with contract R&D services and ensures high-quality product delivery through its independent R&D platform and self-reliant raw material supply chain.
capabilities: Contract R&D services for material development

regional_presence.China: Anji Microelectronics is based in China, operating three manufacturing bases to support its production capacity and global market strategy.
